candidate_name: ONGC/IndianOil wellhead small-scale LNG (SSLNG) program — Hatta (Madhya Pradesh) + Rajahmundry/Ankleshwar/Bokaro/Cambay
sponsor_or_proposer: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) + Indian Oil Corporation Ltd (IOCL)
current_state: MoU signed 17 Jun 2024 for a mini-LNG plant near the Hatta gas field, Vindhyan Basin (Madhya Pradesh); ONGC has identified five further wellhead sites (two at Rajahmundry AP, plus Ankleshwar GJ, Bokaro JH, Cambay GJ). Units are wellhead micro-liquefiers (~32-35 t/day, ~45,000 scm/day) cooling stranded associated gas for road-tanker distribution.
missing_threshold_elements: Out of likely terminal scope rather than below threshold: these are inland wellhead micro-LNG liquefiers (~0.01 MTPA each) for trucked distribution, not marine import/export terminals. Sponsor+location+MoU step are all present, but scale/type fall outside the tracker's terminal universe (no jetty, no marine berth, sub-terminal capacity).
watch_for: Whether GEM methodology decides to track wellhead/inland SSLNG liquefaction at all; or whether any of these sites scale up into a terminal-class facility. Re-check ~mid-2026 / next India batch.
